title: Sensor node with level radar
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sensor node. The sensor node comprises a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement and a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output. Additionally, a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell is provided. This shortens fault detection latency.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement; a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output; and a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell.

title: Battery module with heating film
abstract: Embodiments of a battery module are described, characterised by a liquid-cooled base plate defining a winding fine-channel flow path. Variants include a paraffin composite interposed between neighbouring cells, the composite storing latent heat during melting. The design reduces temperature spread between cells while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A battery module comprising: a liquid-cooled base plate defining a winding fine-channel flow path; a heat-pumping loop operable in heating mode to raise pack temperature in cold weather; and a paraffin composite interposed between neighbouring cells, the composite storing latent heat during melting.
2. The battery module of claim 1, further comprising identifying an overheating cascade from the time derivative of measured cell temperature.
3. The battery module of claim 2, further comprising a processor regulating coolant throughput according to a model predicting thermal gradients between cells.
4. The battery module of claim 3, further comprising a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside.

title: Machine health sensor with gas detection and safety barrier
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a machine health sensor. The machine health sensor comprises a piezoelectric accelerometer for laboratory modal testing with a fixed sampling rate and an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter. Additionally, an intrinsically safe barrier limiting energy delivered to a hazardous area is provided. This reduces maintenance visits.
claims: 1. A machine health sensor comprising: a piezoelectric accelerometer for laboratory modal testing with a fixed sampling rate; an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter; and an intrinsically safe barrier limiting energy delivered to a hazardous area.
2. The machine health sensor of claim 1, further comprising a fibre Bragg grating strain sensor bonded to the structure.

title: Machine health sensor with calibration memory
abstract: Embodiments of a machine health sensor are described, characterised by a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory. Variants include a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output. The design extends battery life while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A machine health sensor comprising: a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory; a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure; and a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output.
2. The machine health sensor of claim 1, further comprising a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell.

title: Sensor node with calibration memory and pressure transmitter
abstract: Embodiments of a sensor node are described, characterised by a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory. Variants include an intrinsically safe barrier limiting energy delivered to a hazardous area. The design lowers installation cost while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory; a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output; and an intrinsically safe barrier limiting energy delivered to a hazardous area.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising an edge computing unit forwarding alarms to a supervisory system.

title: Coating composition with thermal barrier and nickel plating
abstract: Embodiments of a coating composition are described, characterised by a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying. Variants include a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically. The design extends service life in marine environments while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying; an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating; and a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically.
2. The coating composition of claim 1, further comprising a fluorinated topcoat repelling water.

title: Powder bed fusion system with orientation planning and distortion simulation
abstract: A powder bed fusion system is described that has an orientation planner minimising overhang area. In certain embodiments the powder bed fusion system further includes a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry and an abrasive flow process polishing internal channels. The arrangement shortens qualification time.
claims: 1. A powder bed fusion system comprising: an orientation planner minimising overhang area; a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry; and an abrasive flow process polishing internal channels.
2. The powder bed fusion system of claim 1, further comprising a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer.

title: Machine health sensor with fibre sensing
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a machine health sensor. The machine health sensor comprises time-synchronised timestamps shared across nodes of the mesh and correcting sensor offset drift with readings from a nearby thermal resistor. Additionally, a micromachined acceleration transducer whose sampling frequency is raised upon larger oscillation levels is provided. This shortens fault detection latency.
claims: 1. A machine health sensor comprising: time-synchronised timestamps shared across nodes of the mesh; correcting sensor offset drift with readings from a nearby thermal resistor; and a micromachined acceleration transducer whose sampling frequency is raised upon larger oscillation levels.
2. The machine health sensor of claim 1, further comprising a low-power mesh radio that transmits only when the anomaly score exceeds a threshold.
3. The machine health sensor of claim 2, further comprising a vibration-driven piezo generator supplying electrical power to the wireless node.

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with multi-laser zoning
abstract: Embodiments of a layer-wise fabrication method are described, characterised by an infrared imager spotting hot spots under protruding regions and marking the slice. Variants include a slender breakaway rib taken off with an electrical discharge wire. The design shortens qualification time while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A layer-wise fabrication method comprising: an infrared imager spotting hot spots under protruding regions and marking the slice; a CAD processor sorting lower facing faces by their inclination; and a slender breakaway rib taken off with an electrical discharge wire.
2. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 1, further comprising a chessboard sector exposure with square cells of 5 mm.
3. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 2, further comprising a lower beam energy and faster travel used on the underside area.
4. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 3, further comprising a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate.

title: Battery pack with fan control
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a battery pack. The battery pack comprises an elastic buffer pad holding pressure on the cells unchanged as they wear and retained bulge event data within the pack management unit supporting service scheduling. Additionally, an optical fibre gauge placed in the gap between neighbouring cells to sense cell expansion is provided. This extends cycle life.
claims: 1. A battery pack comprising: an elastic buffer pad holding pressure on the cells unchanged as they wear; retained bulge event data within the pack management unit supporting service scheduling; and an optical fibre gauge placed in the gap between neighbouring cells to sense cell expansion.
2. The battery pack of claim 1, further comprising an actuated end plate varying the squeezing pressure depending on detected bulge.
3. The battery pack of claim 2, further comprising a circuit-based estimator tracking resistance increase using step-current behaviour.
4. The battery pack of claim 3, further comprising a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature.

title: Machine health sensor with proximity sensing
abstract: A machine health sensor is disclosed that includes a regression model that outputs flank wear width in micrometres. In some embodiments the machine health sensor further includes a digital twin of the cutting process calibrated using the first workpiece of a batch and a current clamp on the spindle drive phase that records motor load during cutting. The arrangement lowers installation cost.
claims: 1. A machine health sensor comprising: a regression model that outputs flank wear width in micrometres; a digital twin of the cutting process calibrated using the first workpiece of a batch; and a current clamp on the spindle drive phase that records motor load during cutting.
2. The machine health sensor of claim 1, further comprising a link to the machine controller ordering a replacement of the cutter once the estimate hits a bound.
3. The machine health sensor of claim 2, further comprising an acoustic emission sensor attached to the tool holder detecting high-frequency bursts.
4. The machine health sensor of claim 3, further comprising an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target.

title: Coating composition with anti-fouling paint and abrasion resistance
abstract: Embodiments of a coating composition are described, characterised by a copper-free anti-fouling paint releasing a biocide slowly. Variants include a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding. The design lowers solvent emissions while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: a copper-free anti-fouling paint releasing a biocide slowly; ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance; and a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding.
2. The coating composition of claim 1, further comprising a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with stress relief
abstract: A additive manufacturing apparatus is disclosed that includes preheating the build plate with a temperature gradient across its area. In some embodiments the additive manufacturing apparatus further includes a linear optical scanner carried by the spreader inspecting the powder bed for defects and a fast infrared imager from which the molten track width is computed. The arrangement reduces porosity in finished parts.
claims: 1. A additive manufacturing apparatus comprising: preheating the build plate with a temperature gradient across its area; a linear optical scanner carried by the spreader inspecting the powder bed for defects; and a fast infrared imager from which the molten track width is computed.
2. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 1, further comprising an inert gas flow with an oxygen sensor and a spatter shield above the build plate.
3. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 2, further comprising an on-axis optical detector sensing radiation from the molten pool via the scanning optics.
4. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 3, further comprising a post-build stress-relief heat treatment.

title: Coating composition with anti-fouling paint and thermal barrier
abstract: Embodiments of a coating composition are described, characterised by a copper-free anti-fouling paint releasing a biocide slowly. Variants include a fluorinated topcoat repelling water. The design lowers solvent emissions while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: a copper-free anti-fouling paint releasing a biocide slowly; a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying; and a fluorinated topcoat repelling water.
2. The coating composition of claim 1, further comprising a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with powder recycling
abstract: A additive manufacturing apparatus is disclosed that includes a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper. In some embodiments the additive manufacturing apparatus further includes a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry and a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate. The arrangement improves build yield.
claims: 1. A additive manufacturing apparatus comprising: a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper; a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry; and a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate.
2. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a counter-rotating roller spreading powder.

title: Coated article with shielding paint and intumescent paint
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a coated article. The coated article comprises a vibrating probe whose natural frequency change indicates a frozen deposit and a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding. Additionally, a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy is provided. This reduces maintenance repainting.
claims: 1. A coated article comprising: a vibrating probe whose natural frequency change indicates a frozen deposit; a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding; and a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy.
2. The coated article of claim 1, further comprising an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat.
3. The coated article of claim 2, further comprising a lubricant-impregnated textured film reducing the bond strength of ice.

title: Thermal management system with air-cooled housing
abstract: A thermal management system is disclosed that includes a shunt path disconnecting a deteriorating cell cluster while the load stays supplied. In some embodiments the thermal management system further includes an electronic record kept on every module holding past operating data and measurements and a disassembly fixture with a robotic gripper for removing cells from the original pack without damage. The arrangement lowers parasitic cooling power.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: a shunt path disconnecting a deteriorating cell cluster while the load stays supplied; an electronic record kept on every module holding past operating data and measurements; and a disassembly fixture with a robotic gripper for removing cells from the original pack without damage.
2. The thermal management system of claim 1, further comprising a bench that characterises residual capacity and resistance of every used cell using a fixed current-pulse routine.
3. The thermal management system of claim 2, further comprising a relay network changing the series-parallel topology of cell sets while in use.
4. The thermal management system of claim 3, further comprising a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows.

title: Thermal management system with air-cooled housing
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a thermal management system. The thermal management system comprises a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows and a dielectric fluid in which the cells are partially immersed. Additionally, a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases is provided. This extends cycle life.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows; a dielectric fluid in which the cells are partially immersed; and a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases.
2. The thermal management system of claim 1, further comprising a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall.

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with roller spreading and powder recycling
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a layer-wise fabrication method. The layer-wise fabrication method comprises a recoating-blade mounted array detector checking layer uniformity and grooves and a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper. Additionally, a light sensor sharing the laser beam path to record melt-zone brightness is provided. This shortens qualification time.
claims: 1. A layer-wise fabrication method comprising: a recoating-blade mounted array detector checking layer uniformity and grooves; a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper; and a light sensor sharing the laser beam path to record melt-zone brightness.
2. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 1, further comprising a counter-rotating roller spreading powder.
3. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 2, further comprising a fast infrared imager from which the molten track width is computed.
4. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 3, further comprising lattice support structures designed for easy removal.

title: Wireless monitoring system with humidity compensation
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wireless monitoring system. The wireless monitoring system comprises a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings and an ultrasonic transducer pair measuring transit time through the pipe wall. Additionally, a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell is provided. This shortens fault detection latency.
claims: 1. A wireless monitoring system comprising: a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings; an ultrasonic transducer pair measuring transit time through the pipe wall; and a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell.
2. The wireless monitoring system of claim 1, further comprising a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up.
3. The wireless monitoring system of claim 2, further comprising an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter.

title: Battery module with fan control and busbar heat sink
abstract: Embodiments of a battery module are described, characterised by a dielectric fluid in which the cells are partially immersed. Variants include a grouping procedure binning the cells by closeness of measured properties. The design reduces temperature spread between cells while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A battery module comprising: a dielectric fluid in which the cells are partially immersed; a shunt path disconnecting a deteriorating cell cluster while the load stays supplied; and a grouping procedure binning the cells by closeness of measured properties.
2. The battery module of claim 1, further comprising a busbar with an integrated heat sink.
3. The battery module of claim 2, further comprising a relay network changing the series-parallel topology of cell sets while in use.
4. The battery module of claim 3, further comprising a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature.

title: Energy storage assembly with thermal interface pad and cell balancing
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a energy storage assembly. The energy storage assembly comprises a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface and a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells. Additionally, an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid is provided. This extends cycle life.
claims: 1. A energy storage assembly comprising: a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface; a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells; and an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid.

title: Sensor node with self-diagnostics
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sensor node. The sensor node comprises a per-cut summary of average power and band-limited spectral content and an amperage pickup on the main motor lead capturing load while machining. Additionally, a fitted predictor returning the width of flank wear in microns is provided. This shortens fault detection latency.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: a per-cut summary of average power and band-limited spectral content; an amperage pickup on the main motor lead capturing load while machining; and a fitted predictor returning the width of flank wear in microns.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising a simulation model adjusted with the first component of a production run.
3. The sensor node of claim 2, further comprising a stress-wave transducer mounted at the holder registering rapid bursts.
4. The sensor node of claim 3, further comprising a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure.

title: Corrosion protection scheme with thermal barrier
abstract: Embodiments of a corrosion protection scheme are described, characterised by a graphene-filled conductive ink for printed electronics. Variants include a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy. The design reduces maintenance repainting while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A corrosion protection scheme comprising: a graphene-filled conductive ink for printed electronics; a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying; and a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy.
2. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 1, further comprising an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating.

title: Corrosion protection scheme with hydrophobic topcoat
abstract: Embodiments of a corrosion protection scheme are described, characterised by a crustacean-derived polysaccharide acting as a charring agent expanding into a cellular layer. Variants include a phosphorus compound obtained from grain husk phytate. The design extends service life in marine environments while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A corrosion protection scheme comprising: a crustacean-derived polysaccharide acting as a charring agent expanding into a cellular layer; exfoliating graphite platelets boosting the swelling factor; and a phosphorus compound obtained from grain husk phytate.
2. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 1, further comprising an aqueous acrylate vehicle emitting under fifty grams per litre of volatile organics.
3. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 2, further comprising a calorimetric verification demanding forty per cent lower peak heat release.
4. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 3, further comprising a fluorinated topcoat repelling water.

title: Energy storage assembly with aerogel cover and heating film
abstract: Embodiments of a energy storage assembly are described, characterised by a charger that stops charging completely below zero degrees without any heating. Variants include a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside. The design reduces temperature spread between cells while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A energy storage assembly comprising: a charger that stops charging completely below zero degrees without any heating; an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid; and a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside.
2. The energy storage assembly of claim 1, further comprising a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface.

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with roller spreading
abstract: Embodiments of a layer-wise fabrication method are described, characterised by a counter-rotating roller spreading powder. Variants include a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers. The design lowers scrap rate while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A layer-wise fabrication method comprising: a counter-rotating roller spreading powder; a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry; and a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers.
2. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 1, further comprising hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores.

title: Wireless monitoring system with humidity compensation
abstract: A wireless monitoring system is disclosed that includes a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings. In some embodiments the wireless monitoring system further includes a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory and a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement. The arrangement reduces maintenance visits.
claims: 1. A wireless monitoring system comprising: a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings; a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory; and a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement.
2. The wireless monitoring system of claim 1, further comprising a fibre Bragg grating strain sensor bonded to the structure.

title: Powder bed fusion system with binder jetting and powder recycling
abstract: Embodiments of a powder bed fusion system are described, characterised by a manual tungsten arc welding of repair patches. Variants include a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper. The design improves build yield while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A powder bed fusion system comprising: a manual tungsten arc welding of repair patches; a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer; and a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper.
2. The powder bed fusion system of claim 1, further comprising a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate.

title: Powder bed fusion system with support structures and graded lattice
abstract: A powder bed fusion system is disclosed that includes lattice support structures designed for easy removal. In some embodiments the powder bed fusion system further includes a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size and a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm. The arrangement improves build yield.
claims: 1. A powder bed fusion system comprising: lattice support structures designed for easy removal; a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size; and a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm.
2. The powder bed fusion system of claim 1, further comprising a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate.

title: Laser melting machine with powder recycling and part marking
abstract: Embodiments of a laser melting machine are described, characterised by a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper. Variants include a counter-rotating roller spreading powder. The design shortens qualification time while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A laser melting machine comprising: a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper; a data matrix mark printed on each part for traceability; and a counter-rotating roller spreading powder.
2. The laser melting machine of claim 1, further comprising an orientation planner minimising overhang area.

title: Powder bed fusion system with multi-laser zoning
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a powder bed fusion system. The powder bed fusion system comprises a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate and a post-build stress-relief heat treatment. Additionally, a counter-rotating roller spreading powder is provided. This reduces porosity in finished parts.
claims: 1. A powder bed fusion system comprising: a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate; a post-build stress-relief heat treatment; and a counter-rotating roller spreading powder.
2. The powder bed fusion system of claim 1, further comprising a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size.

title: Protective coating system with nickel plating and shielding paint
abstract: Embodiments of a protective coating system are described, characterised by an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating. Variants include a fluorinated topcoat repelling water. The design improves adhesion on steel while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A protective coating system comprising: an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating; a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding; and a fluorinated topcoat repelling water.
2. The protective coating system of claim 1, further comprising a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically.

title: Sensor node with pressure transmitter and humidity compensation
abstract: A sensor node is disclosed that includes a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output. In some embodiments the sensor node further includes a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings and a gateway aggregating readings from field devices over a long-range radio link. The arrangement shortens fault detection latency.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output; a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings; and a gateway aggregating readings from field devices over a long-range radio link.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target.

title: Wireless monitoring system with self-diagnostics and safety barrier
abstract: Embodiments of a wireless monitoring system are described, characterised by a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure. Variants include a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output. The design lowers installation cost while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A wireless monitoring system comprising: a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure; an intrinsically safe barrier limiting energy delivered to a hazardous area; and a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output.

title: Thermal management system with thermal interface pad
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a thermal management system. The thermal management system comprises an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid and a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface. Additionally, a robot-held extractor unfastening cells from the source assembly undamaged is provided. This extends cycle life.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid; a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface; and a robot-held extractor unfastening cells from the source assembly undamaged.
2. The thermal management system of claim 1, further comprising an electronic record kept on every module holding past operating data and measurements.
3. The thermal management system of claim 2, further comprising a plurality of thermistors bonded to cell surfaces.

title: Condition monitoring device with level radar
abstract: Embodiments of a condition monitoring device are described, characterised by a wired vibration sensor powered from a mains supply that transmits continuously. Variants include a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up. The design lowers installation cost while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A condition monitoring device comprising: a wired vibration sensor powered from a mains supply that transmits continuously; a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement; and a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up.
2. The condition monitoring device of claim 1, further comprising an intrinsically safe barrier limiting energy delivered to a hazardous area.

title: Sensor node with scheduled logger
abstract: Embodiments of a sensor node are described, characterised by a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up. Variants include an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter. The design lowers installation cost while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up; a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement; and an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising a fibre Bragg grating strain sensor bonded to the structure.

title: Laser melting machine with pore closing
abstract: Embodiments of a laser melting machine are described, characterised by a closed vessel carrying material in an inert atmosphere avoiding contact with ambient air. Variants include hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores. The design lowers scrap rate while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A laser melting machine comprising: a closed vessel carrying material in an inert atmosphere avoiding contact with ambient air; a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm; and hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores.
2. The laser melting machine of claim 1, further comprising a timed pour of the material through a standard cone to judge its fluidity.
3. The laser melting machine of claim 2, further comprising a ledger associating each component with its feedstock lot and recycling count.
4. The laser melting machine of claim 3, further comprising a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer.

title: Condition monitoring device with humidity compensation
abstract: A condition monitoring device is disclosed that includes a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings. In some embodiments the condition monitoring device further includes a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure and an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter. The arrangement reduces maintenance visits.
claims: 1. A condition monitoring device comprising: a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings; a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure; and an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter.
2. The condition monitoring device of claim 1, further comprising a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement.

title: Coating composition with chromium-free pretreatment
abstract: Embodiments of a coating composition are described, characterised by a voltage-based flaw finder discovering tiny defects in the layer. Variants include a magnetic heating loop raising the pipe to a set temperature prior to coating. The design improves adhesion on steel while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: a voltage-based flaw finder discovering tiny defects in the layer; an RFID marker placed at the weld keeping the coating data and worker identification; and a magnetic heating loop raising the pipe to a set temperature prior to coating.
2. The coating composition of claim 1, further comprising an epoxy base coat cured with a polyamine applied on the abrasive-cleaned weld area.
3. The coating composition of claim 2, further comprising a shrink-fit band bearing a bituminous glue placed around the pipe joint.
4. The coating composition of claim 3, further comprising a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate.

title: Battery pack with heating film
abstract: A battery pack is disclosed that includes a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside. In some embodiments the battery pack further includes a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases and an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell. The arrangement extends cycle life.
claims: 1. A battery pack comprising: a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside; a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases; and an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell.
2. The battery pack of claim 1, further comprising a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells.
3. The battery pack of claim 2, further comprising an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid.

title: Protective coating system with nickel plating and chromium-free pretreatment
abstract: A protective coating system is disclosed that includes an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating. In some embodiments the protective coating system further includes a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate and an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat. The arrangement reduces maintenance repainting.
claims: 1. A protective coating system comprising: an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating; a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate; and an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat.

title: Coating composition with low-solvent binder and carbon film
abstract: Embodiments of a coating composition are described, characterised by a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content. Variants include an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating. The design extends service life in marine environments while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content; a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition; and an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating.

title: Sensor node with edge unit
abstract: A sensor node is disclosed that includes a cross-correlation of signals from two sensors to locate the leak position along the pipe. In some embodiments the sensor node further includes a low-bandwidth mobile connection sending a daily probability figure and a trained model separating the sound of a breach from machinery and road disturbance. The arrangement extends battery life.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: a cross-correlation of signals from two sensors to locate the leak position along the pipe; a low-bandwidth mobile connection sending a daily probability figure; and a trained model separating the sound of a breach from machinery and road disturbance.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising a solar cell and a supercapacitor supplying the transmitter in the street cabinet.
3. The sensor node of claim 2, further comprising a sound pickup mounted on the pipeline surface capturing noise generated by escaping fluid.
4. The sensor node of claim 3, further comprising an edge computing unit forwarding alarms to a supervisory system.

title: Sensor node with gas detection
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sensor node. The sensor node comprises an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter and an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target. Additionally, a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure is provided. This lowers installation cost.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter; an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target; and a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings.

title: Coating composition with abrasion resistance and chromium-free pretreatment
abstract: Embodiments of a coating composition are described, characterised by a built-in electrode pair measuring AC impedance to follow coating ageing. Variants include an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating. The design lowers solvent emissions while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: a built-in electrode pair measuring AC impedance to follow coating ageing; a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate; and an electroless nickel-phosphorus plating.
2. The coating composition of claim 1, further comprising encapsulated inhibitor-filled shells that rupture upon cracking and discharge their payload.
3. The coating composition of claim 2, further comprising ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance.
4. The coating composition of claim 3, further comprising layered carbon nanoplatelets lying flat in a thermoset binder forming a barrier.

title: Thermal management system with sealed enclosure
abstract: Embodiments of a thermal management system are described, characterised by an alternating current excitation at a selected frequency that warms the cell through internal impedance. Variants include a lookup-based amperage ceiling that varies with cell temperature held in controller memory. The design reduces temperature spread between cells while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: an alternating current excitation at a selected frequency that warms the cell through internal impedance; an insulated pack lid with aerogel panels reducing heat loss in parked vehicles; and a lookup-based amperage ceiling that varies with cell temperature held in controller memory.
2. The thermal management system of claim 1, further comprising a lithium plating detector that analyses the voltage plateau during relaxation after charging.
3. The thermal management system of claim 2, further comprising a warm-up timetable matched to the route target and planned departure.
4. The thermal management system of claim 3, further comprising a sealed pack enclosure with a pressure-equalising membrane.

title: Powder bed fusion system with scan strategy and multi-laser zoning
abstract: A powder bed fusion system is disclosed that includes a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers. In some embodiments the powder bed fusion system further includes a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate and an orientation planner minimising overhang area. The arrangement shortens qualification time.
claims: 1. A powder bed fusion system comprising: a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers; a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate; and an orientation planner minimising overhang area.
2. The powder bed fusion system of claim 1, further comprising a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper.

title: Sensor node with proximity sensing
abstract: A sensor node is disclosed that includes an inspection aperture in the door using material transparent to heat radiation. In some embodiments the sensor node further includes an initial learned curve of typical warming against loading and an optical flash detector that opens the circuit breaker in a few milliseconds. The arrangement extends battery life.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: an inspection aperture in the door using material transparent to heat radiation; an initial learned curve of typical warming against loading; and an optical flash detector that opens the circuit breaker in a few milliseconds.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising an in-cabinet radio scanner querying the labels on a schedule.
3. The sensor node of claim 2, further comprising an unpowered acoustic-wave label at each conductor junction conveying heat readings.
4. The sensor node of claim 3, further comprising an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target.

title: Wireless monitoring system with pressure transmitter
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wireless monitoring system. The wireless monitoring system comprises correlating recordings from neighbouring units to pinpoint the location of the fault in the pipe run and a learned discriminator telling leak signatures apart from pump or vehicle interference. Additionally, a sound pickup mounted on the pipeline surface capturing noise generated by escaping fluid is provided. This shortens fault detection latency.
claims: 1. A wireless monitoring system comprising: correlating recordings from neighbouring units to pinpoint the location of the fault in the pipe run; a learned discriminator telling leak signatures apart from pump or vehicle interference; and a sound pickup mounted on the pipeline surface capturing noise generated by escaping fluid.
2. The wireless monitoring system of claim 1, further comprising a sun-powered supply using a high-capacity capacitor for the sender in the kerbside housing.
3. The wireless monitoring system of claim 2, further comprising sampling during the small hours when customer-induced sound is lowest.
4. The wireless monitoring system of claim 3, further comprising a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output.

title: Energy storage assembly with busbar heat sink and air-cooled housing
abstract: A energy storage assembly is disclosed that includes a busbar with an integrated heat sink. In some embodiments the energy storage assembly further includes a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows and a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall. The arrangement reduces temperature spread between cells.
claims: 1. A energy storage assembly comprising: a busbar with an integrated heat sink; a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows; and a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall.
2. The energy storage assembly of claim 1, further comprising a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface.

title: Sensor node with safety barrier
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sensor node. The sensor node comprises a reader aerial within the enclosure polling the transponders periodically and a viewing port of IR-transmitting glass built into the panel front. Additionally, a baseline of normal temperature rise as a function of load current learned during commissioning is provided. This lowers installation cost.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: a reader aerial within the enclosure polling the transponders periodically; a viewing port of IR-transmitting glass built into the panel front; and a baseline of normal temperature rise as a function of load current learned during commissioning.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising an arc flash sensor with light detection tripping a breaker within milliseconds.
3. The sensor node of claim 2, further comprising a batteryless SAW transponder on every bar connection returning its temperature wirelessly.
4. The sensor node of claim 3, further comprising an intrinsically safe barrier limiting energy delivered to a hazardous area.

title: Battery pack with fan control
abstract: A battery pack is disclosed that includes a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature. In some embodiments the battery pack further includes a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface and a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows. The arrangement reduces temperature spread between cells.
claims: 1. A battery pack comprising: a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature; a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface; and a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows.
2. The battery pack of claim 1, further comprising a dielectric fluid in which the cells are partially immersed.

title: Sensor node with self-diagnostics
abstract: A sensor node is disclosed that includes an overnight recording period used because demand-related noise is minimal. In some embodiments the sensor node further includes a sound pickup mounted on the pipeline surface capturing noise generated by escaping fluid and a photovoltaic panel with an ultracapacitor powering the radio in the roadside box. The arrangement reduces maintenance visits.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: an overnight recording period used because demand-related noise is minimal; a sound pickup mounted on the pipeline surface capturing noise generated by escaping fluid; and a photovoltaic panel with an ultracapacitor powering the radio in the roadside box.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising a time-delay comparison between a pair of detectors to determine where along the line the leak is.
3. The sensor node of claim 2, further comprising a low-bandwidth mobile connection sending a daily probability figure.
4. The sensor node of claim 3, further comprising a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure.

title: Powder bed fusion system with wire deposition and orientation planning
abstract: A powder bed fusion system is disclosed that includes an orientation planner minimising overhang area. In some embodiments the powder bed fusion system further includes a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size and a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm. The arrangement reduces porosity in finished parts.
claims: 1. A powder bed fusion system comprising: an orientation planner minimising overhang area; a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size; and a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm.
2. The powder bed fusion system of claim 1, further comprising a robotic route computed from the slices with unbroken spiral passes.
3. The powder bed fusion system of claim 2, further comprising a following inert gas shoe guarding the solidifying track against oxygen.
4. The powder bed fusion system of claim 3, further comprising a rolling wheel compressing every weld track immediately after deposition.

title: Laser melting machine with part marking
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a laser melting machine. The laser melting machine comprises a powder bed system that uses no wire and a data matrix mark printed on each part for traceability. Additionally, a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers is provided. This shortens qualification time.
claims: 1. A laser melting machine comprising: a powder bed system that uses no wire; a data matrix mark printed on each part for traceability; and a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers.
2. The laser melting machine of claim 1, further comprising an abrasive flow process polishing internal channels.

title: Machine health sensor with scheduled logger
abstract: A machine health sensor is disclosed that includes a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up. In some embodiments the machine health sensor further includes a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell and a fibre Bragg grating strain sensor bonded to the structure. The arrangement lowers installation cost.
claims: 1. A machine health sensor comprising: a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up; a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell; and a fibre Bragg grating strain sensor bonded to the structure.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with stress relief and wire deposition
abstract: Embodiments of a additive manufacturing apparatus are described, characterised by a post-build stress-relief heat treatment. Variants include an abrasive flow process polishing internal channels. The design shortens qualification time while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A additive manufacturing apparatus comprising: a post-build stress-relief heat treatment; a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm; and an abrasive flow process polishing internal channels.
2. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a counter-rotating roller spreading powder.

title: Protective coating system with hydrophobic topcoat
abstract: Embodiments of a protective coating system are described, characterised by an ice sensor measuring the resonance shift of a vibrating element. Variants include a soot-loaded polymer film that takes up solar radiation and warms. The design improves adhesion on steel while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A protective coating system comprising: an ice sensor measuring the resonance shift of a vibrating element; silica nanoparticles giving fine scale texture; and a soot-loaded polymer film that takes up solar radiation and warms.
2. The protective coating system of claim 1, further comprising a rain erosion resistant leading edge shield of thermoplastic polyurethane tape.
3. The protective coating system of claim 2, further comprising a lubricant-impregnated textured film reducing the bond strength of ice.
4. The protective coating system of claim 3, further comprising a fluorinated topcoat repelling water.

title: Energy storage assembly with thermal interface pad (continuation)
abstract: A energy storage assembly is described that has a detection routine examining the voltage plateau in the rest phase after a charge for deposition of metallic lithium. In some embodiments the energy storage assembly further includes an oscillating current applied at a chosen frequency heating the cell by its inner resistance and a thermally insulating cover using aerogel boards limiting cooling of a stationary car. The arrangement lowers parasitic cooling power.
claims: 1. A energy storage assembly comprising: a detection routine examining the voltage plateau in the rest phase after a charge for deposition of metallic lithium; an oscillating current applied at a chosen frequency heating the cell by its inner resistance; and a thermally insulating cover using aerogel boards limiting cooling of a stationary car.
2. The energy storage assembly of claim 1, further comprising a resistive metal sheet inside the electrode assembly warmed by the battery's discharge current.
3. The energy storage assembly of claim 2, further comprising a lookup-based amperage ceiling that varies with cell temperature held in controller memory.

title: Sensor node with thermocouple assembly and humidity compensation
abstract: A sensor node is disclosed that includes a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell. In some embodiments the sensor node further includes a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings and a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory. The arrangement lowers installation cost.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell; a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings; and a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising an edge computing unit forwarding alarms to a supervisory system.
3. The sensor node of claim 2, further comprising an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target.

title: Corrosion protection scheme with carbon film
abstract: Embodiments of a corrosion protection scheme are described, characterised by a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition. Variants include a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding. The design lowers solvent emissions while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A corrosion protection scheme comprising: a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition; an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat; and a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding.
2. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 1, further comprising a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate.

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with binder jetting
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a layer-wise fabrication method. The layer-wise fabrication method comprises a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer and a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm. Additionally, a post-build stress-relief heat treatment is provided. This shortens qualification time.
claims: 1. A layer-wise fabrication method comprising: a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer; a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm; and a post-build stress-relief heat treatment.
2. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 1, further comprising a data matrix mark printed on each part for traceability.

title: Battery module with heat pipe and graphite sheet
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a battery module. The battery module comprises a swelling-resistant cell casing made of thick steel and a heat pipe transferring heat from the module core to a condenser section. Additionally, a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall is provided. This lowers parasitic cooling power.
claims: 1. A battery module comprising: a swelling-resistant cell casing made of thick steel; a heat pipe transferring heat from the module core to a condenser section; and a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall.
2. The battery module of claim 1, further comprising an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell.

title: Coating composition with hydrophobic topcoat
abstract: Embodiments of a coating composition are described, characterised by a qualification measurement in a calorimeter with a 40% reduction in maximum heat output. Variants include an aqueous acrylate vehicle emitting under fifty grams per litre of volatile organics. The design improves adhesion on steel while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: a qualification measurement in a calorimeter with a 40% reduction in maximum heat output; a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding; and an aqueous acrylate vehicle emitting under fifty grams per litre of volatile organics.
2. The coating composition of claim 1, further comprising a fluorinated topcoat repelling water.
3. The coating composition of claim 2, further comprising a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content.
4. The coating composition of claim 3, further comprising a transparent polyurethane overcoat shielding the swelling layer from humidity.

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with multi-laser zoning (continuation)
abstract: Embodiments of a layer-wise fabrication method are described, characterised by an infrared imager spotting hot spots under protruding regions and marking the slice. 2. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 1, further comprising a chessboard sector exposure with square cells of 5 mm.
3. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 2, further comprising a lower beam energy and faster travel used on the underside area.

title: Sensor node with pressure transmitter
abstract: Embodiments of a sensor node are described, characterised by a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output. Variants include an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target. The design reduces maintenance visits while keeping cost low.

title: Wireless monitoring system with humidity compensation and edge unit
abstract: Embodiments of a wireless monitoring system are described, characterised by a periodic manual thermographic survey by an engineer. Variants include an edge computing unit forwarding alarms to a supervisory system. The design reduces maintenance visits while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A wireless monitoring system comprising: a periodic manual thermographic survey by an engineer; a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings; and an edge computing unit forwarding alarms to a supervisory system.
2. The wireless monitoring system of claim 1, further comprising a gateway aggregating readings from field devices over a long-range radio link.

title: Thermal management system with busbar heat sink
abstract: A thermal management system is disclosed that includes a busbar with an integrated heat sink. claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: a busbar with an integrated heat sink; a dielectric fluid in which the cells are partially immersed; and a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall.

title: Corrosion protection scheme with shielding paint
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a corrosion protection scheme. The corrosion protection scheme comprises curing by ultraviolet light-emitting diodes to a dry film thickness of 80 to 120 micrometres and an in-film impedance spectroscopy probe tracking deterioration of the protective layer. Additionally, an organosilane coupling agent on an abrasively blasted metal surface is provided. This extends service life in marine environments.
claims: 1. A corrosion protection scheme comprising: curing by ultraviolet light-emitting diodes to a dry film thickness of 80 to 120 micrometres; an in-film impedance spectroscopy probe tracking deterioration of the protective layer; and an organosilane coupling agent on an abrasively blasted metal surface.
2. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 1, further comprising graphene oxide platelets aligned parallel to the surface within an epoxy matrix.
3. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 2, further comprising encapsulated inhibitor-filled shells that rupture upon cracking and discharge their payload.
4. The corrosion protection scheme of claim 3, further comprising a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding.

title: Battery module with heat spreader foils and air-cooled housing
abstract: Embodiments of a battery module are described, characterised by an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell. Variants include a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases. The design improves fast-charging performance while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A battery module comprising: an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell; a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows; and a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases.
2. The battery module of claim 1, further comprising a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature.

title: Sensor node with calibration memory and pressure transmitter
abstract: Embodiments of a sensor node are described, characterised by a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory. claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory; a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output; and an intrinsically safe barrier limiting energy delivered to a hazardous area.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising an edge computing unit forwarding alarms to a supervisory system.

title: Wireless monitoring system with humidity compensation
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wireless monitoring system. The wireless monitoring system comprises a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings and a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output. Additionally, an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter is provided. This reduces maintenance visits.
claims: 1. A wireless monitoring system comprising: a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings; a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output; and an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter.
2. The wireless monitoring system of claim 1, further comprising a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory.
3. The wireless monitoring system of claim 2, further comprising a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement.

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with orientation planning and support structures
abstract: A layer-wise fabrication method is disclosed that includes lattice support structures designed for easy removal. In some embodiments the layer-wise fabrication method further includes a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate and an orientation planner minimising overhang area. The arrangement improves build yield.
claims: 1. A layer-wise fabrication method comprising: lattice support structures designed for easy removal; a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate; and an orientation planner minimising overhang area.
2. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 1, further comprising a gas-extraction analyser quantifying oxygen and nitrogen in the feedstock.
3. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 2, further comprising a scattering instrument determining grain size spread of reclaimed material.
4. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 3, further comprising a mixer combining reclaimed and fresh powder in a proportion chosen from measurements.

title: Battery module with immersion cooling and thermal interface pad
abstract: A battery module is disclosed that includes a cooling plate having straight macro-channels fed by a fixed-speed pump. In some embodiments the battery module further includes a dielectric fluid in which the cells are partially immersed and a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface. The arrangement extends cycle life.
claims: 1. A battery module comprising: a cooling plate having straight macro-channels fed by a fixed-speed pump; a dielectric fluid in which the cells are partially immersed; and a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface.
2. The battery module of claim 1, further comprising an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell.

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with powder recycling
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a layer-wise fabrication method. The layer-wise fabrication method comprises a recoater with a brush made of carbon fibre and a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper. Additionally, hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores is provided. This lowers scrap rate.
claims: 1. A layer-wise fabrication method comprising: a recoater with a brush made of carbon fibre; a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper; and hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores.
2. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 1, further comprising a post-build stress-relief heat treatment.

title: Condition monitoring device with level radar
abstract: A condition monitoring device is disclosed that has a viewing port of IR-transmitting glass built into the panel front. In certain embodiments the condition monitoring device further includes a notification raised if heat surpasses the reference by a set offset for a hold period and a reader aerial within the enclosure polling the transponders periodically. The arrangement lowers maintenance visits.
claims: 1. A condition monitoring device comprising: a viewing port of IR-transmitting glass built into the panel front; a notification raised if heat surpasses the reference by a set offset for a hold period; and a reader aerial within the enclosure polling the transponders periodically.
2. The condition monitoring device of claim 1, further comprising a batteryless SAW transponder on every bar connection returning its temperature wirelessly.
3. The condition monitoring device of claim 2, further comprising a reference of expected heating versus current established at start-up.

title: Coating composition with abrasion resistance and chromium-free pretreatment
abstract: A coating composition is disclosed that includes ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance. In some embodiments the coating composition further includes a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate and a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating. The arrangement extends service life in marine environments.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance; a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate; and a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating.
2. The coating composition of claim 1, further comprising a copper-free anti-fouling paint releasing a biocide slowly.

title: Battery module with busbar heat sink
abstract: Embodiments of a battery module are described, characterised by a relay network changing the series-parallel topology of cell sets while in use. Variants include a shunt path disconnecting a deteriorating cell cluster while the load stays supplied. The design extends cycle life while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A battery module comprising: a relay network changing the series-parallel topology of cell sets while in use; a bench that characterises residual capacity and resistance of every used cell using a fixed current-pulse routine; and a shunt path disconnecting a deteriorating cell cluster while the load stays supplied.
2. The battery module of claim 1, further comprising an unsupervised sorting routine assembling cells with similar characteristics into batches using the characterised values.
3. The battery module of claim 2, further comprising an electronic record kept on every module holding past operating data and measurements.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with pore closing and binder jetting
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a additive manufacturing apparatus. The additive manufacturing apparatus comprises hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores and a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer. Additionally, a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry is provided. This shortens qualification time.
claims: 1. A additive manufacturing apparatus comprising: hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores; a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer; and a thermal distortion simulation used to pre-compensate part geometry.
2. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers.

title: Energy storage assembly with fan control

Additionally, a busbar with an integrated heat sink is provided. This lowers parasitic cooling power.
claims: 1. A energy storage assembly comprising: a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature; a dielectric fluid in which the cells are partially immersed; and a busbar with an integrated heat sink.

title: Wireless monitoring system with pressure transmitter
abstract: A wireless monitoring system is disclosed that includes a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output. title: Thermal management system with graphite sheet
abstract: Embodiments of a thermal management system are described, characterised by a recycling process that shreds modules to recover metals. Variants include a plurality of thermistors bonded to cell surfaces. The design improves fast-charging performance while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: a recycling process that shreds modules to recover metals; a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall; and a plurality of thermistors bonded to cell surfaces.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with pore closing
abstract: A additive manufacturing apparatus is disclosed that has a structured light profilometer measuring the track elevation upon completion of every pass. In certain embodiments the additive manufacturing apparatus further includes a rolling wheel compressing every weld track immediately after deposition and a following inert gas shoe guarding the solidifying track against oxygen. The arrangement improves build yield.
claims: 1. A additive manufacturing apparatus comprising: a structured light profilometer measuring the track elevation upon completion of every pass; a rolling wheel compressing every weld track immediately after deposition; and a following inert gas shoe guarding the solidifying track against oxygen.

3. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a regulator altering the filament feed rate to hold the following layer thickness on setpoint.

title: Battery pack with derated charging
abstract: Embodiments of a battery pack are described, characterised by a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases. Variants include a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells. The design reduces temperature spread between cells while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A battery pack comprising: a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases; an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid; and a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells.
2. The battery pack of claim 1, further comprising a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with stress relief
abstract: A additive manufacturing apparatus is disclosed that includes preheating the build plate with a temperature gradient across its area. In certain embodiments the additive manufacturing apparatus further includes a linear optical scanner carried by the spreader inspecting the powder bed for defects and a fast infrared imager from which the molten track width is computed. The arrangement reduces porosity in finished parts.
claims: 1. A additive manufacturing apparatus comprising: preheating the build plate with a temperature gradient across its area; a linear optical scanner carried by the spreader inspecting the powder bed for defects; and a fast infrared imager from which the molten track width is computed.
2. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 1, further comprising an inert gas flow with an oxygen sensor and a spatter shield above the build plate.
3. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 2, further comprising an on-axis optical detector sensing radiation from the molten pool via the scanning optics.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with binder jetting and stress relief
