4. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 3, further comprising a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm.

title: Machine health sensor with level radar (continuation)
abstract: Embodiments of a machine health sensor are described, characterised by a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement. Variants include a gateway aggregating readings from field devices over a long-range radio link. The design lowers installation cost while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A machine health sensor comprising: a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement; a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory; and a gateway aggregating readings from field devices over a long-range radio link.
2. The machine health sensor of claim 1, further comprising an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter.

title: Machine health sensor with safety barrier
abstract: A machine health sensor is disclosed that includes correlating recordings from neighbouring units to pinpoint the location of the fault in the pipe run. In some embodiments the machine health sensor further includes a photovoltaic panel with an ultracapacitor powering the radio in the roadside box and a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up. The arrangement shortens fault detection latency.
claims: 1. A machine health sensor comprising: correlating recordings from neighbouring units to pinpoint the location of the fault in the pipe run; a photovoltaic panel with an ultracapacitor powering the radio in the roadside box; and a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up.
2. The machine health sensor of claim 1, further comprising an intrinsically safe barrier limiting energy delivered to a hazardous area.
3. The machine health sensor of claim 2, further comprising a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure.

title: Protective coating system with intumescent paint
abstract: A protective coating system is disclosed that includes a buried electrically heated layer supplied by a regulator. In some embodiments the protective coating system further includes an oil-filled porous topcoat decreasing frozen-water adhesion and silica nanoparticles giving fine scale texture. The arrangement improves adhesion on steel.
claims: 1. A protective coating system comprising: a buried electrically heated layer supplied by a regulator; an oil-filled porous topcoat decreasing frozen-water adhesion; and silica nanoparticles giving fine scale texture.
2. The protective coating system of claim 1, further comprising a pigmented elastomer sheet turning sunshine into thermal energy.
3. The protective coating system of claim 2, further comprising a sacrificial edge guard of polymer tape resisting raindrop wear.
4. The protective coating system of claim 3, further comprising an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat.

title: Laser melting machine with multi-laser zoning and stress relief
abstract: Embodiments of a laser melting machine are described, characterised by a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate. Variants include an orientation planner minimising overhang area. The design improves build yield while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A laser melting machine comprising: a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate; a post-build stress-relief heat treatment; and an orientation planner minimising overhang area.
2. The laser melting machine of claim 1, further comprising a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size.

title: Laser melting machine with powder recycling and orientation planning
abstract: A laser melting machine is disclosed that includes a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper. In some embodiments the laser melting machine further includes an orientation planner minimising overhang area and a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm. The arrangement lowers scrap rate.
claims: 1. A laser melting machine comprising: a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper; an orientation planner minimising overhang area; and a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm.
2. The laser melting machine of claim 1, further comprising an abrasive flow process polishing internal channels.

title: Coating composition with anti-fouling paint and thermal barrier
abstract: Embodiments of a coating composition are described, characterised by a copper-free anti-fouling paint releasing a biocide slowly. Variants include a fluorinated topcoat repelling water. The design lowers solvent emissions while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: a copper-free anti-fouling paint releasing a biocide slowly; a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying; and a fluorinated topcoat repelling water.
2. The coating composition of claim 1, further comprising a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content.

title: Protective coating system with low-solvent binder and anodising
abstract: A protective coating system is disclosed that includes a zinc electroplating bath for fasteners. In some embodiments the protective coating system further includes a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content and a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy. The arrangement extends service life in marine environments.
claims: 1. A protective coating system comprising: a zinc electroplating bath for fasteners; a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content; and a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy.
2. The protective coating system of claim 1, further comprising ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance.

title: Coated article with chromium-free pretreatment and sol-gel layer
abstract: Embodiments of a coated article are described, characterised by a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate. Variants include a see-through PU finish guarding the intumescent film against water. The design improves adhesion on steel while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A coated article comprising: a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate; an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat; and a see-through PU finish guarding the intumescent film against water.
2. The coated article of claim 1, further comprising a water-based acrylic carrier with low solvent emissions below 50 g/L.
3. The coated article of claim 2, further comprising a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating.

title: Coated article with chromium-free pretreatment
abstract: Embodiments of a coated article are described, characterised by a pull-off adhesion test recording the load in megapascals. Variants include a bi-component epoxide undercoat with an amine curing agent spread over the blasted joint region. The design reduces maintenance repainting while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A coated article comprising: a pull-off adhesion test recording the load in megapascals; a radio-readable label embedded at the connection holding process settings and installer identity; and a bi-component epoxide undercoat with an amine curing agent spread over the blasted joint region.
2. The coated article of claim 1, further comprising an induction heating coil that preheats the steel to a defined temperature before application.
3. The coated article of claim 2, further comprising a thermally contracting wrap with sticky sealant covering the circumferential weld.
4. The coated article of claim 3, further comprising a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate.

title: Battery pack with fan control and air-cooled housing
abstract: Embodiments of a battery pack are described, characterised by a warm-up timetable matched to the route target and planned departure. Variants include a thermally insulating cover using aerogel boards limiting cooling of a stationary car. The design extends cycle life while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A battery pack comprising: a warm-up timetable matched to the route target and planned departure; an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid; and a thermally insulating cover using aerogel boards limiting cooling of a stationary car.
2. The battery pack of claim 1, further comprising a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature.
3. The battery pack of claim 2, further comprising a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows.
4. The battery pack of claim 3, further comprising an oscillating current applied at a chosen frequency heating the cell by its inner resistance.

title: Laser melting machine with stress relief
abstract: A laser melting machine is disclosed that includes a control unit varying the consumable delivery speed so that the subsequent pass matches the desired height. In some embodiments the laser melting machine further includes a robotic route computed from the slices with unbroken spiral passes and a pyrometer ensuring the workpiece cools beneath a bound prior to the next deposit. The arrangement lowers scrap rate.
claims: 1. A laser melting machine comprising: a control unit varying the consumable delivery speed so that the subsequent pass matches the desired height; a robotic route computed from the slices with unbroken spiral passes; and a pyrometer ensuring the workpiece cools beneath a bound prior to the next deposit.
2. The laser melting machine of claim 1, further comprising an optical profile sensor recording the ridge height of each finished layer.
3. The laser melting machine of claim 2, further comprising a pressing cylinder working the fresh track before it cools.
4. The laser melting machine of claim 3, further comprising a post-build stress-relief heat treatment.

title: Coated article with thermal barrier
abstract: A coated article is disclosed that includes a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying. In some embodiments the coated article further includes a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy and a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically. The arrangement lowers solvent emissions.
claims: 1. A coated article comprising: a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying; a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy; and a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically.
2. The coated article of claim 1, further comprising a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate.
3. The coated article of claim 2, further comprising a fluorinated topcoat repelling water.

title: Coating composition with powder coating
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a coating composition. The coating composition comprises a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically and a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition. Additionally, a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding is provided. This extends service life in marine environments.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically; a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition; and a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding.
2. The coating composition of claim 1, further comprising a protective strip along the front edge made of tough elastomer adhesive tape guarding against droplet impact.
3. The coating composition of claim 2, further comprising a pigmented elastomer sheet turning sunshine into thermal energy.
4. The coating composition of claim 3, further comprising a lubricant-impregnated textured film reducing the bond strength of ice.

title: Powder bed fusion system with support structures
abstract: Embodiments of a powder bed fusion system are described, characterised by a thin sacrificial gusset that is removed by wire cutting. Variants include a learned predictor based on earlier jobs forecasting dross from exposure settings. The design improves build yield while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A powder bed fusion system comprising: a thin sacrificial gusset that is removed by wire cutting; a CAD processor sorting lower facing faces by their inclination; and a learned predictor based on earlier jobs forecasting dross from exposure settings.
2. The powder bed fusion system of claim 1, further comprising a reduced laser power and increased scan speed assigned to the downskin region.
3. The powder bed fusion system of claim 2, further comprising an infrared imager spotting hot spots under protruding regions and marking the slice.
4. The powder bed fusion system of claim 3, further comprising lattice support structures designed for easy removal.

title: Thermal management system with heat spreader foils and aerogel cover
abstract: Embodiments of a thermal management system are described, characterised by an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell. Variants include a sealed pack enclosure with a pressure-equalising membrane. The design extends cycle life while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell; an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid; and a sealed pack enclosure with a pressure-equalising membrane.

title: Coated article with low-solvent binder
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a coated article. The coated article comprises a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content and a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition. Additionally, a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding is provided. This extends service life in marine environments.
claims: 1. A coated article comprising: a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content; a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition; and a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding.
2. The coated article of claim 1, further comprising a sealed anodic oxide layer on an aluminium alloy.

title: Thermal management system with heating film and thermal interface pad
abstract: Embodiments of a thermal management system are described, characterised by a busbar with an integrated heat sink. Variants include a lumped electrical model deriving rising ohmic resistance from the response to current pulses. The design improves fast-charging performance while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: a busbar with an integrated heat sink; an optical fibre gauge placed in the gap between neighbouring cells to sense cell expansion; and a lumped electrical model deriving rising ohmic resistance from the response to current pulses.
2. The thermal management system of claim 1, further comprising a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside.
3. The thermal management system of claim 2, further comprising a stored log of expansion incidents in controller memory used to plan servicing.
4. The thermal management system of claim 3, further comprising a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface.

title: Protective coating system with shielding paint and low-solvent binder
abstract: A protective coating system is disclosed that includes a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding. In some embodiments the protective coating system further includes a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content and a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating. The arrangement lowers solvent emissions.
claims: 1. A protective coating system comprising: a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding; a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content; and a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating.
2. The protective coating system of claim 1, further comprising a copper-free anti-fouling paint releasing a biocide slowly.
3. The protective coating system of claim 2, further comprising ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance.

title: Battery module with derated charging
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a battery module. The battery module comprises a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases and a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells. Additionally, a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside is provided. This improves fast-charging performance.
claims: 1. A battery module comprising: a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases; a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells; and a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside.
2. The battery module of claim 1, further comprising a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall.
3. The battery module of claim 2, further comprising a plurality of thermistors bonded to cell surfaces.

title: Coating composition with carbon film and abrasion resistance
abstract: Embodiments of a coating composition are described, characterised by a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition. Variants include an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat. The design reduces maintenance repainting while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition; ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance; and an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat.
2. The coating composition of claim 1, further comprising a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate.

title: Battery pack with heat pipe
abstract: A battery pack is disclosed that includes a diagnostic fixture determining remaining charge capability and ohmic resistance for each reclaimed cell by a uniform pulse sequence. In some embodiments the battery pack further includes a switching fabric dynamically altering how cell clusters are interconnected and a shunt path disconnecting a deteriorating cell cluster while the load stays supplied. The arrangement improves fast-charging performance.
claims: 1. A battery pack comprising: a diagnostic fixture determining remaining charge capability and ohmic resistance for each reclaimed cell by a uniform pulse sequence; a switching fabric dynamically altering how cell clusters are interconnected; and a shunt path disconnecting a deteriorating cell cluster while the load stays supplied.
2. The battery pack of claim 1, further comprising a grouping procedure binning the cells by closeness of measured properties.
3. The battery pack of claim 2, further comprising a robot-held extractor unfastening cells from the source assembly undamaged.
4. The battery pack of claim 3, further comprising a heat pipe transferring heat from the module core to a condenser section.

title: Powder bed fusion system with scan strategy and roller spreading (continuation)
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a powder bed fusion system. The powder bed fusion system comprises a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers and a counter-rotating roller spreading powder. Additionally, hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores is provided. This lowers scrap rate.
claims: 1. A powder bed fusion system comprising: a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers; a counter-rotating roller spreading powder; and hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores.
2. The powder bed fusion system of claim 1, further comprising a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size.

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with graded lattice and orientation planning
abstract: Embodiments of a layer-wise fabrication method are described, characterised by a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size. Variants include an abrasive flow process polishing internal channels. The design improves build yield while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A layer-wise fabrication method comprising: a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size; an orientation planner minimising overhang area; and an abrasive flow process polishing internal channels.
2. The layer-wise fabrication method of claim 1, further comprising a data matrix mark printed on each part for traceability.

title: Wireless monitoring system with thermocouple assembly
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wireless monitoring system. The wireless monitoring system comprises a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell and an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target. Additionally, a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings is provided. This reduces maintenance visits.
claims: 1. A wireless monitoring system comprising: a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell; an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target; and a humidity compensation step applied to capacitive readings.
2. The wireless monitoring system of claim 1, further comprising a gateway aggregating readings from field devices over a long-range radio link.
3. The wireless monitoring system of claim 2, further comprising a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up.

title: Energy storage assembly with heat pipe
abstract: A energy storage assembly is disclosed that includes a heat pipe transferring heat from the module core to a condenser section. In some embodiments the energy storage assembly further includes a sealed pack enclosure with a pressure-equalising membrane and a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows. The arrangement reduces temperature spread between cells.
claims: 1. A energy storage assembly comprising: a heat pipe transferring heat from the module core to a condenser section; a sealed pack enclosure with a pressure-equalising membrane; and a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows.

title: Battery module with heat pipe
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a battery module. The battery module comprises an external pressure gauge used only during end-of-line testing and a heat pipe transferring heat from the module core to a condenser section. Additionally, a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature is provided. This improves fast-charging performance.
claims: 1. A battery module comprising: an external pressure gauge used only during end-of-line testing; a heat pipe transferring heat from the module core to a condenser section; and a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature.
2. The battery module of claim 1, further comprising a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells.

title: Condition monitoring device with self-diagnostics
abstract: Embodiments of a condition monitoring device are described, characterised by a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure. Variants include an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target. The design reduces maintenance visits while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A condition monitoring device comprising: a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure; a fibre Bragg grating strain sensor bonded to the structure; and an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with pore closing
abstract: A additive manufacturing apparatus is disclosed that includes a structured light profilometer measuring the track elevation upon completion of every pass. In some embodiments the additive manufacturing apparatus further includes a rolling wheel compressing every weld track immediately after deposition and a following inert gas shoe guarding the solidifying track against oxygen. The arrangement improves build yield.
claims: 1. A additive manufacturing apparatus comprising: a structured light profilometer measuring the track elevation upon completion of every pass; a rolling wheel compressing every weld track immediately after deposition; and a following inert gas shoe guarding the solidifying track against oxygen.
2. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a pyrometer ensuring the workpiece cools beneath a bound prior to the next deposit.
3. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a regulator altering the filament feed rate to hold the following layer thickness on setpoint.
4. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 3, further comprising hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores.

title: Machine health sensor with gas detection and scheduled logger
abstract: A machine health sensor is disclosed that includes an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter. In some embodiments the machine health sensor further includes a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up and an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target. The arrangement lowers installation cost.
claims: 1. A machine health sensor comprising: an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter; a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up; and an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target.
2. The machine health sensor of claim 1, further comprising a fibre Bragg grating strain sensor bonded to the structure.
3. The machine health sensor of claim 2, further comprising a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell.

title: Battery module with heating film
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a battery module. The battery module comprises a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside and a plurality of thermistors bonded to cell surfaces. Additionally, an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell is provided. This extends cycle life.
claims: 1. A battery module comprising: a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside; a plurality of thermistors bonded to cell surfaces; and an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell.

title: Laser melting machine with part marking
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a laser melting machine. The laser melting machine comprises a gas-extraction analyser quantifying oxygen and nitrogen in the feedstock and a blending station that mixes used powder with virgin powder at a ratio selected from the measured properties. Additionally, a sealed transfer container that moves the powder under argon without exposure to air is provided. This improves build yield.
claims: 1. A laser melting machine comprising: a gas-extraction analyser quantifying oxygen and nitrogen in the feedstock; a blending station that mixes used powder with virgin powder at a ratio selected from the measured properties; and a sealed transfer container that moves the powder under argon without exposure to air.
2. The laser melting machine of claim 1, further comprising a laser diffraction analyser that measures the particle size distribution of recycled powder.
3. The laser melting machine of claim 2, further comprising a batch record that links every part to the powder lot and the number of reuse cycles.
4. The laser melting machine of claim 3, further comprising a data matrix mark printed on each part for traceability.

title: Corrosion protection scheme with chromium-free pretreatment and carbon film
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a corrosion protection scheme. The corrosion protection scheme comprises a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate and a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition. Additionally, an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat is provided. This improves adhesion on steel.
claims: 1. A corrosion protection scheme comprising: a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate; a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition; and an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat.

title: Energy storage assembly with graphite sheet
abstract: A energy storage assembly is disclosed that includes a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall. In some embodiments the energy storage assembly further includes an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid and a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows. The arrangement lowers parasitic cooling power.
claims: 1. A energy storage assembly comprising: a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall; an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid; and a module housing with forced-air cooling ducts between cell rows.
2. The energy storage assembly of claim 1, further comprising a plurality of thermistors bonded to cell surfaces.

title: Battery pack with heat spreader foils
abstract: Embodiments of a battery pack are described, characterised by an expanding fire-retardant layer together with an exhaust duct guiding vented gases out of the housing. Variants include a monitoring circuit flagging a cell failure event upon a temperature slope above a limit. The design enhances fast-charging performance while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A battery pack comprising: an expanding fire-retardant layer together with an exhaust duct guiding vented gases out of the housing; a paraffin composite interposed between neighbouring cells, the composite storing latent heat during melting; and a monitoring circuit flagging a cell failure event upon a temperature slope above a limit.
2. The battery pack of claim 1, further comprising a cold plate with meandering micro-channels carrying liquid coolant beneath the cells.
3. The battery pack of claim 2, further comprising a control unit setting pump speed from a forecast of temperature differences across the cells.

title: Protective coating system with hydrophobic topcoat
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a protective coating system. The protective coating system comprises a fluorinated topcoat repelling water and a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding. Additionally, a non-contact eddy current gauge for measuring film thickness is provided. This lowers solvent emissions.
claims: 1. A protective coating system comprising: a fluorinated topcoat repelling water; a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding; and a non-contact eddy current gauge for measuring film thickness.
2. The protective coating system of claim 1, further comprising a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying.

title: Coated article with powder coating and carbon film
abstract: Embodiments of a coated article are described, characterised by a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically. Variants include an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat. The design enhances adhesion on steel while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A coated article comprising: a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically; a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition; and an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat.
2. The coated article of claim 1, further comprising a fluorinated topcoat repelling water.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with surface finishing
abstract: Embodiments of a additive manufacturing apparatus are described, characterised by a sealed transfer container that moves the powder under argon without exposure to air. Variants include a laser diffraction analyser that measures the particle size distribution of recycled powder. The design shortens qualification time while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A additive manufacturing apparatus comprising: a sealed transfer container that moves the powder under argon without exposure to air; a flow assessment timing the outflow through a calibrated funnel; and a laser diffraction analyser that measures the particle size distribution of recycled powder.
2. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a ledger associating each component with its feedstock lot and recycling count.
3. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a blending station that mixes used powder with virgin powder at a ratio selected from the measured properties.
4. The additive manufacturing apparatus of claim 3, further comprising an abrasive flow process polishing internal channels.

title: Energy storage assembly with heat spreader foils
abstract: A energy storage assembly is disclosed that includes an intumescent barrier and a venting channel that directs ejected gas away from adjacent cells. In some embodiments the energy storage assembly further includes a paraffin composite interposed between neighbouring cells, the composite storing latent heat during melting and a controller that adjusts coolant flow rate using a predictive model of the cell temperature gradient. The arrangement lowers parasitic cooling power.
claims: 1. A energy storage assembly comprising: an intumescent barrier and a venting channel that directs ejected gas away from adjacent cells; a paraffin composite interposed between neighbouring cells, the composite storing latent heat during melting; and a controller that adjusts coolant flow rate using a predictive model of the cell temperature gradient.
2. The energy storage assembly of claim 1, further comprising a monitoring circuit flagging a cell failure event upon a temperature slope above a limit.
3. The energy storage assembly of claim 2, further comprising a bidirectional refrigerant circuit warming the pack before charging at low temperature.
4. The energy storage assembly of claim 3, further comprising an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell.

title: Coated article with sol-gel layer
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a coated article. The coated article comprises a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating and a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition. Additionally, a fluorinated topcoat repelling water is provided. This lowers solvent emissions.
claims: 1. A coated article comprising: a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating; a diamond-like carbon film deposited by physical vapour deposition; and a fluorinated topcoat repelling water.
2. The coated article of claim 1, further comprising a copper-free anti-fouling paint releasing a biocide slowly.

title: Machine health sensor with level radar
abstract: Embodiments of a machine health sensor are described, characterised by a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement. Variants include a gateway aggregating readings from field devices over a long-range radio link. The design lowers installation cost while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A machine health sensor comprising: a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement; a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory; and a gateway aggregating readings from field devices over a long-range radio link.
2. The machine health sensor of claim 1, further comprising an electrochemical gas detection cell with a replaceable filter.
3. The machine health sensor of claim 2, further comprising a diaphragm pressure transmitter with a current loop output.

title: Battery pack with heat spreader foils
abstract: A battery pack is disclosed that includes an electronic record kept on every module holding past operating data and measurements. In some embodiments the battery pack further includes a disassembly fixture with a robotic gripper for removing cells from the original pack without damage and a testing station that measures capacity and impedance of each retired cell with a standardised pulse protocol. The arrangement reduces temperature spread between cells.
claims: 1. A battery pack comprising: an electronic record kept on every module holding past operating data and measurements; a disassembly fixture with a robotic gripper for removing cells from the original pack without damage; and a testing station that measures capacity and impedance of each retired cell with a standardised pulse protocol.
2. The battery pack of claim 1, further comprising a shunt path disconnecting a deteriorating cell cluster while the load stays supplied.
3. The battery pack of claim 2, further comprising a reconfigurable switch matrix that rewires series and parallel connections of the cell groups during operation.
4. The battery pack of claim 3, further comprising an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell.

title: Sensor node with scheduled logger and self-diagnostics
abstract: A sensor node is disclosed that includes an unpowered acoustic-wave label at each conductor junction conveying heat readings. In some embodiments the sensor node further includes a reference of expected heating versus current established at start-up and a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure. The arrangement lowers installation cost.
claims: 1. A sensor node comprising: an unpowered acoustic-wave label at each conductor junction conveying heat readings; a reference of expected heating versus current established at start-up; and a self-diagnostic function reporting sensor element failure.
2. The sensor node of claim 1, further comprising an optical flash detector that opens the circuit breaker in a few milliseconds.
3. The sensor node of claim 2, further comprising a battery-powered data logger with scheduled wake-up.
4. The sensor node of claim 3, further comprising a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory.

title: Laser melting machine with multi-laser zoning and orientation planning
abstract: A laser melting machine is disclosed that includes a learned predictor based on earlier jobs forecasting dross from exposure settings. In some embodiments the laser melting machine further includes a lower beam energy and faster travel used on the underside area and a heat imaging device finding excess temperature below protrusions and tagging the layer. The arrangement lowers scrap rate.
claims: 1. A laser melting machine comprising: a learned predictor based on earlier jobs forecasting dross from exposure settings; a lower beam energy and faster travel used on the underside area; and a heat imaging device finding excess temperature below protrusions and tagging the layer.
2. The laser melting machine of claim 1, further comprising a sieving station returning unfused powder to the hopper.
3. The laser melting machine of claim 2, further comprising a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate.
4. The laser melting machine of claim 3, further comprising an orientation planner minimising overhang area.

title: Protective coating system with low-solvent binder (continuation)
abstract: Embodiments of a protective coating system are described, characterised by a tensile bond measurement logged in MPa. Variants include a bi-component epoxide undercoat with an amine curing agent spread over the blasted joint region. The design extends service life in marine environments while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A protective coating system comprising: a tensile bond measurement logged in MPa; a thermally contracting wrap with sticky sealant covering the circumferential weld; and a bi-component epoxide undercoat with an amine curing agent spread over the blasted joint region.
2. The protective coating system of claim 1, further comprising a magnetic heating loop raising the pipe to a set temperature prior to coating.
3. The protective coating system of claim 2, further comprising a spark tester using high voltage to reveal pinholes in the film.

title: Coating composition with thermal barrier
abstract: A coating composition is disclosed that includes an organosilane coupling agent on an abrasively blasted metal surface. In some embodiments the coating composition further includes microcapsules containing a corrosion inhibitor that release when a crack forms in the coating and graphene oxide platelets aligned parallel to the surface within an epoxy matrix. The arrangement lowers solvent emissions.
claims: 1. A coating composition comprising: an organosilane coupling agent on an abrasively blasted metal surface; microcapsules containing a corrosion inhibitor that release when a crack forms in the coating; and graphene oxide platelets aligned parallel to the surface within an epoxy matrix.

3. The coating composition of claim 2, further comprising an undercoat loaded with zinc dust protecting the steel galvanically.
4. The coating composition of claim 3, further comprising a yttria-stabilised zirconia layer deposited by plasma spraying.

title: Protective coating system with abrasion resistance
abstract: Embodiments of a protective coating system are described, characterised by ceramic particles dispersed in a polyurethane binder for abrasion resistance. Variants include a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically. The design lowers solvent emissions while keeping cost low.

title: Powder bed fusion system with support structures
abstract: Embodiments of a powder bed fusion system are described, characterised by a thin sacrificial gusset that is removed by wire cutting. Variants include a learned predictor based on earlier jobs forecasting dross from exposure settings. The design enhances build yield while keeping cost low.

2. The powder bed fusion system of claim 1, further comprising a reduced laser power and increased scan speed assigned to the downskin region.
3. The powder bed fusion system of claim 2, further comprising an infrared imager spotting hot spots under protruding regions and marking the slice.

title: Coated article with intumescent paint and sol-gel layer
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a coated article. claims: 1. A coated article comprising: an intumescent paint layer that swells when exposed to heat; a sol-gel silica layer applied by dip coating; and a silver-filled conductive coating for electromagnetic shielding.

title: Battery pack with fan control
abstract: A battery pack is disclosed that includes a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature. In some embodiments the battery pack further includes a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside and a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases. The arrangement improves fast-charging performance.
claims: 1. A battery pack comprising: a fan whose duty cycle follows the highest measured cell temperature; a resistive heating film attached to the pack underside; and a charging profile that derates current as cell temperature increases.
2. The battery pack of claim 1, further comprising a pyrolytic graphite sheet conducting heat toward a side wall.

title: Powder bed fusion system with scan strategy and roller spreading
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a powder bed fusion system. The powder bed fusion system comprises a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers and a counter-rotating roller spreading powder. Additionally, hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores is provided. This lowers scrap rate.
claims: 1. A powder bed fusion system comprising: a stripe scan strategy rotated by sixty-seven degrees between layers; a counter-rotating roller spreading powder; and hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores.

title: Condition monitoring device with level radar
abstract: A condition monitoring device is disclosed that includes a viewing port of IR-transmitting glass built into the panel front. In some embodiments the condition monitoring device further includes a notification raised if heat surpasses the reference by a set offset for a hold period and a reader aerial within the enclosure polling the transponders periodically. The arrangement reduces maintenance visits.
claims: 1. A condition monitoring device comprising: a viewing port of IR-transmitting glass built into the panel front; a notification raised if heat surpasses the reference by a set offset for a hold period; and a reader aerial within the enclosure polling the transponders periodically.

3. The condition monitoring device of claim 2, further comprising a reference of expected heating versus current established at start-up.
4. The condition monitoring device of claim 3, further comprising a guided-wave radar probe for tank level measurement.

title: Machine health sensor with calibration memory
abstract: Embodiments of a machine health sensor are described, characterised by a simulation model adjusted with the first component of a production run. Variants include an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target. The design reduces maintenance visits while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A machine health sensor comprising: a simulation model adjusted with the first component of a production run; a calibration routine storing correction coefficients in non-volatile memory; and an inductive proximity sensor detecting a rotating target.
2. The machine health sensor of claim 1, further comprising a mineral-insulated thermocouple with a thermowell.
3. The machine health sensor of claim 2, further comprising a fitted predictor returning the width of flank wear in microns.
4. The machine health sensor of claim 3, further comprising a per-cut summary of average power and band-limited spectral content.

title: Thermal management system with heat pipe
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a thermal management system. The thermal management system comprises a liquid-cooled base plate defining a winding fine-channel flow path and a heat pipe transferring heat from the module core to a condenser section. Additionally, a paraffin composite interposed between neighbouring cells, the composite storing latent heat during melting is provided. This extends cycle life.
claims: 1. A thermal management system comprising: a liquid-cooled base plate defining a winding fine-channel flow path; a heat pipe transferring heat from the module core to a condenser section; and a paraffin composite interposed between neighbouring cells, the composite storing latent heat during melting.
2. The thermal management system of claim 1, further comprising a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface.
3. The thermal management system of claim 2, further comprising a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells.

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with binder jetting and wire deposition
abstract: A layer-wise fabrication method is disclosed that includes a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer. In some embodiments the layer-wise fabrication method further includes a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm and hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores. The arrangement lowers scrap rate.
claims: 1. A layer-wise fabrication method comprising: a binder jetting printhead depositing a binder on a powder layer; a wire-fed arc deposition head mounted on a robot arm; and hot isostatic pressing to close internal pores.

title: Corrosion protection scheme with chromium-free pretreatment
abstract: A corrosion protection scheme is disclosed that includes a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate. In some embodiments the corrosion protection scheme further includes a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically and a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content. The arrangement lowers solvent emissions.
claims: 1. A corrosion protection scheme comprising: a chromium-free conversion pretreatment of an aluminium substrate; a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically; and a water-borne acrylic dispersion with reduced solvent content.

title: Protective coating system with powder coating
abstract: Embodiments of a protective coating system are described, characterised by a cone calorimeter acceptance test requiring a peak heat release rate reduction of forty percent. claims: 1. 3. The protective coating system of claim 2, further comprising a phosphorus compound obtained from grain husk phytate.
4. The protective coating system of claim 3, further comprising a thermosetting polyester powder applied electrostatically.

title: Battery module with aerogel cover
abstract: Embodiments of a battery module are described, characterised by an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid. Variants include an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell. The design improves fast-charging performance while keeping cost low.
claims: 1. A battery module comprising: an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid; a sealed pack enclosure with a pressure-equalising membrane; and an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell.
2. The battery module of claim 1, further comprising a plurality of thermistors bonded to cell surfaces.

title: Battery module with heat spreader foils
abstract: A battery module is disclosed that includes an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell. title: Machine health sensor with safety barrier
abstract: Embodiments of a machine health sensor are described, characterised by a sound pickup mounted on the pipeline surface capturing noise generated by escaping fluid. title: Protective coating system with hydrophobic topcoat
abstract: Embodiments of a protective coating system are described, characterised by a shell-derived biopolymer supplying carbon for a bubbled residue under heat. title: Condition monitoring device with proximity sensing

title: Energy storage assembly with cell balancing and fan control
abstract: A energy storage assembly is disclosed that includes a balancing circuit that equalises the state of charge of series-connected cells. title: Energy storage assembly with cell balancing and immersion cooling
abstract: Embodiments of a energy storage assembly are described, characterised by a rigid clamp frame with fixed bolts that does not respond to cell expansion. title: Protective coating system with thickness gauge and anti-fouling paint
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a protective coating system. title: Energy storage assembly with thermal interface pad
abstract: A energy storage assembly is disclosed that includes a detection routine examining the voltage plateau in the rest phase after a charge for deposition of metallic lithium. In some embodiments the energy storage assembly further includes an oscillating current applied at a chosen frequency heating the cell by its inner resistance and a thermally insulating cover using aerogel boards limiting cooling of a stationary car. The arrangement lowers parasitic cooling power.
claims: 1. 4. The energy storage assembly of claim 3, further comprising a compressible thermal interface pad between the cell and a cooling surface.

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with stress relief
abstract: A additive manufacturing apparatus is disclosed that includes a flow assessment timing the outflow through a calibrated funnel. In some embodiments the additive manufacturing apparatus further includes a gas-extraction analyser quantifying oxygen and nitrogen in the feedstock and a scattering instrument determining grain size spread of reclaimed material. The arrangement lowers scrap rate.
claims: 1. A additive manufacturing apparatus comprising: a flow assessment timing the outflow through a calibrated funnel; a gas-extraction analyser quantifying oxygen and nitrogen in the feedstock; and a scattering instrument determining grain size spread of reclaimed material.

title: Coating composition with hydrophobic topcoat
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a coating composition. The coating composition comprises encapsulated inhibitor-filled shells that rupture upon cracking and discharge their payload and flake-like graphitic nanosheets oriented in-plane inside a cured epoxy resin. title: Coating composition with chromium-free pretreatment and sol-gel layer
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a coating composition. title: Wireless monitoring system with calibration memory

title: Coated article with shielding paint and abrasion resistance

title: Powder bed fusion system with orientation planning

title: Layer-wise fabrication method with multi-laser zoning
abstract: A layer-wise fabrication method is disclosed that includes a plurality of lasers each assigned to a zone of the build plate. In some embodiments the layer-wise fabrication method further includes a data matrix mark printed on each part for traceability and a topology-optimised lattice with graded cell size. The arrangement shortens qualification time.

title: Thermal management system with heat spreader foils and sealed enclosure
abstract: Embodiments of a thermal management system are described, characterised by an aluminium heat-spreading foil wrapped around each cylindrical cell. Variants include an aerogel insulation blanket covering the pack lid. The design extends cycle life while keeping cost low.

title: Battery module with air-cooled housing
abstract: Embodiments of a battery module are described, characterised by an intumescent barrier and a venting channel that directs ejected gas away from adjacent cells. Variants include a monitoring circuit flagging a cell failure event upon a temperature slope above a limit. The design reduces temperature spread between cells while keeping cost low.

3. The battery module of claim 2, further comprising a cold plate with meandering micro-channels carrying liquid coolant beneath the cells.

title: Coated article with chromium-free pretreatment
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a coated article. The coated article comprises a carbon black filled polyurethane layer absorbing sunlight and converting it to heat and a nanosilica additive roughening the surface at the sub-micron scale. title: Battery module with busbar heat sink and heating film

title: Laser melting machine with pore closing

title: Additive manufacturing apparatus with binder jetting
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a additive manufacturing apparatus.
